title: Summarising and closing
intro: End every call with a quick summary, clear action items with owners, and a polite goodbye.
introNative: हर call को एक quick summary, owners के साथ साफ़ action items, और एक polite goodbye के साथ खत्म करें।

phrases.text: To summarise, we've agreed to go live on the 5th.
phrases.native: संक्षेप में, हम 5 तारीख को go live करने पर सहमत हुए हैं।
phrases.note: Signal the end of the call with a one-line summary.

phrases.text: The action items are: we'll fix the export bug, and you'll share the test accounts.
phrases.native: Action items ये हैं: हम export bug fix करेंगे, और आप test accounts share करेंगे।
phrases.note: Every action item needs an owner.

phrases.text: I'll send the minutes after the call.
phrases.native: Call के बाद मैं minutes भेज दूँगा।
phrases.note: "Minutes" are the written notes of a meeting.

phrases.text: Is there anything else we need to cover today?
phrases.native: क्या आज हमें कुछ और cover करना है?
phrases.note: Give everyone a last chance to speak.

phrases.text: Thanks for your time, everyone. Speak to you on Thursday.
phrases.native: आप सबका समय देने के लिए धन्यवाद। गुरुवार को बात करते हैं।
phrases.note: Mention the next meeting so everyone knows what comes next.

steps.prompt: The call is almost over. How do you start wrapping up?
steps.promptNative: Call लगभग खत्म होने वाली है। आप wrap up कैसे शुरू करेंगे?
options: Okay, that's all, bye.
To summarise, we've agreed to go live on the 5th.
So finally the conclusion is go-live is on 5th only.
steps.answer: To summarise, we've agreed to go live on the 5th.
steps.explanation: A short summary makes sure everyone leaves with the same understanding.
steps.explanationNative: एक short summary से यह पक्का होता है कि सब एक ही समझ के साथ call से जाएँ।

steps.promptNative: Call के बाद मैं minutes भेज दूँगा।
steps.answer: I'll send the minutes after the call.

steps.audioText: Is there anything else we need to cover today?
options: Is there anything else we need to discover today?
Is there anyone else we need to call today?
Is there anything else we need to cover today?
steps.answer: Is there anything else we need to cover today?

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: Please share your feedbacks on the minutes.
options: Please share your feedbacks on the minutes.
Please share your feedback on the minutes.
Please share your feedbacks about the minutes.
Kindly share the feedbacks for the minutes.
steps.answer: Please share your feedback on the minutes.
steps.explanation: "Feedback" is uncountable, so it never takes a plural "s".
steps.explanationNative: "Feedback" uncountable है, इसलिए इसमें कभी plural "s" नहीं लगता।

steps.prompt: You want to make sure the client knows who is doing what after the call. What do you say?
steps.promptNative: आप पक्का करना चाहते हैं कि client को पता हो कि call के बाद कौन क्या करेगा। आप क्या कहेंगे?
options: Both sides will do the needful.
The action items are: we'll fix the export bug, and you'll share the test accounts.
We will do our part, you do your part.
steps.answer: The action items are: we'll fix the export bug, and you'll share the test accounts.
steps.explanation: Name each task and who owns it.
steps.explanationNative: हर task बताइए और यह भी कि उसका owner कौन है।

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: Please revert back with your comments by Friday.
options: Please revert back with your comments by Friday.
Please send us your comments by Friday.
Please revert with your comments by Friday itself.
Kindly revert back your comments by Friday.
steps.answer: Please send us your comments by Friday.
steps.explanation: "Revert" doesn't mean "reply" in international English; simply ask them to send their comments.
steps.explanationNative: International English में "revert" का मतलब "reply" नहीं होता; बस उनसे अपने comments भेजने को कहिए।

steps.promptNative: आप सबका समय देने के लिए धन्यवाद।

steps.audioText: To summarise, we've agreed to go live on the 5th.
options: To summarise, we've agreed to go live on the 15th.
To summarise, we've agreed to go live on the 5th.
To summarise, we haven't agreed on the go-live date.
steps.answer: To summarise, we've agreed to go live on the 5th.

steps.prompt: Think of your last client call. Out loud, close it in 3–4 sentences: summarise the decision, list the action items with owners, and say what happens next.
steps.promptNative: अपनी पिछली client call के बारे में सोचिए। 3–4 sentences में बोलकर उसे close कीजिए: decision summarise करें, owners के साथ action items बताएँ, और कहें कि आगे क्या होगा।
